insights.body: App Total Revenue moved -10.0% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -10.0%, YMK -8.6%, YCP -14.1%, YCV -7.6%). YCP accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Install source — App Total Install -3.4% — Paid Install is behind most of it (-4,441, -5.5%).
insights.body: App Total Install was 178,394, against 184,592 for last week — a change of -6,198. Where that came from: Paid Install -4,441 (-5.5%), SEO Install -755 (-6.4%), Organic Install -658 (-0.7%). Paid Install moved the most on its own (-4,441, -5.5%) and is now 43.0% of all installs, so that is the channel to look at first.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YCP is turning installs into New Subs better than usual (-24.1% vs Install -90.7%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCP New Subs -24.1% vs Install -90.7% (better than its installs); YMK New Subs +12.8% vs Install +23.7% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which country — US is out of line with every other country on App Total Install (+10.1% vs -3.4%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total Install in US is +10.1% while all countries together are -3.4% — a gap of +13.5pp. US is about 41% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — YCP turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (138.0% vs 13.6% overall).
insights.body: In YCP, 138.0% of installs turn into new subs, versus 13.6% across all markets and apps (+124.4pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. YCP is about 38% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -24.1% this period.
